legacy/tests/workspaceScopePg.test.ts.reason: describe.skipIf(!pgUrl). Cross-tenant scope, duplicate id, version conflict, global-replace ownership and the newer-schema refusal and the v9 per-workspace row-id key need a real PostgreSQL server (PG_TEST_URL or DATABASE_URL).
